name: Necromancer: Abomination Command Zombie Plague scales once without double scaling (#10393)
contract: Command: Abomination 504865 describes the Abomination's Command attack as dealing $504022m1+$505223m2+$505223ppl2+$504022ppl1+$SP*0.1 Plague damage (SchoolMask 40, Nature|Shadow) to nearby enemies.

At level 35 (AscensionScalingBase 0.424424), Zombie Plague 504022 base is int(79 * 0.424424) = 33 and Command: Expel Plague 505223 effect 1 is 40 + 3 * (35 - 10) = 115, giving 148 damage at 0 spell power and 348 damage at +2000 spell power (ratio 2.351, +0.10 SP coefficient).

Before the repair, DoAction passed Amount(504022) + Amount(505223) into Copy(..., 504022), re-running AscensionScalingBase and necromancer_scaling a second time: level 35 base damage was crushed to 63 instead of 148, and spell power was added twice (ratio 5.524 instead of 2.351).
